policy: Do not ingest dictionary entries until data licensing is verified; keep provenance on every imported entry.

sources.name: Asawan — Lexique Soninké-Français-Anglais
sources.action: Use as a lookup/reference source; ask rights holder or locate explicit dataset licence before bulk extraction.

sources.name: Asawan — guides de lecture et d’écriture
sources.action: Link to guides; do not copy book pages or illustrations into the app without explicit rights.

sources.name: snk_engine — soninké structuré, règles et corpus
sources.action: Use the pinned speaker-translated corpus for sentence practice with attribution. Preserve original spelling and source; distinguish source-validated from revalidated by this app.

sources.name: Jàngileen — dictionnaire wolof
sources.action: Maintain the sourced snapshot with the importer workflow. Audit variants, part of speech, and examples; do not describe this as the complete dictionary until the remaining source coverage is reconciled.
sources.importNotes: The automated snapshot currently contains 750 French–Wolof records with per-entry source URLs. Jàngileen reports 911 Wolof words; this count is not directly comparable to the number of extracted French headword/sense records. Source examples are preserved without assigning a language because the site's example labels are inconsistent and need review.

sources.name: Baatukaay — dictionnaire Wolof-Français
sources.action: Inspect repository licence and data provenance separately before importing entries.

sources.name: Kaikki / Wiktionary — dictionnaire wolof structuré
sources.action: Potential source for headwords, part of speech, senses and forms; keep source page and attribution.

sources.name: Wolof-English dictionary / phrase resources
sources.action: Review repository README, licence and source provenance before copying vocabulary.

sources.name: Wiktionary English
sources.action: Use as a reference or import only through a licence-compliant process.

sources.name: French machine-readable dictionary
sources.action: Use for definitions, inflections and parts of speech; do not treat generated examples as verified language pedagogy.

sources.name: Ousmane Moussa Diagana — Dictionnaire soninké-français (Mauritanie), Karthala 2011
sources.action: Use as a linguistic reference for editorial comparison. Do not copy entries into the app without explicit permission or a separate open licence.

sources.name: Ch. Monteil / V. Monteil — Vocabulaire soninké I–II
sources.action: Bibliographic reference only. Historical western Soninke data and transcription require careful dialect and orthography notes; no bulk import until rights and source text are confirmed.

sources.name: ASJP — listes comparatives Soninke
sources.action: Potential source for a small comparative vocabulary; preserve the original transcription, gloss, variety/source and CC BY 4.0 attribution; do not silently normalize into the core lexicon.

sources.name: Mayoiga — Soninke-dataset (Hugging Face)
sources.action: Do not import until the dataset owner and underlying Calaméo text rights are clarified; use as a lead for research only.

reviewStatus: research-started; licence review and dataset extraction not yet complete
